product_stories_distinct_revision_pointe.name: product_stories_distinct_revision_pointers
product_stories_distinct_revision_pointe.value: "product_stories"."published_revision_id" IS NULL OR "product_stories"."draft_revision_id" IS NULL OR "product_stories"."published_revision_id" <> "product_stories"."draft_revision_id"

carts_ownership_xor_check.name: carts_ownership_xor_check
carts_ownership_xor_check.value: ("carts"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "carts"."session_token" IS NULL) OR ("carts"."customer_id" IS NULL AND "carts"."session_token" IS NOT NULL)

ai_research_job_items_mode_product_snaps.name: ai_research_job_items_mode_product_snapshot_check
ai_research_job_items_mode_product_snaps.value: ("ai_research_job_items"."mode" = 'CREATE' AND "ai_research_job_items"."target_product_id" IS NULL AND "ai_research_job_items"."target_product_version_snapshot" IS NULL) OR ("ai_research_job_items"."mode" = 'ENRICH' AND "ai_research_job_items"."target_product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_research_job_items"."target_product_version_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

ai_sources_url_or_citation_check.name: ai_sources_url_or_citation_check
ai_sources_url_or_citation_check.value: "ai_sources"."original_url" IS NOT NULL OR "ai_sources"."provider_citation_id" IS NOT NULL

ai_provider_attempts_cost_integrity_chec.name: ai_provider_attempts_cost_integrity_check
ai_provider_attempts_cost_integrity_chec.value: ("ai_provider_attempts"."cost_source" = 'UNAVAILABLE' AND "ai_provider_attempts"."cost_micros" IS NULL AND "ai_provider_attempts"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("ai_provider_attempts"."cost_source" IN ('ESTIMATED', 'PROVIDER_REPORTED') AND "ai_provider_attempts"."cost_micros" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_provider_attempts"."currency" IS NOT NULL)
